stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Why is the report all red?

stations.title: Shop laptop
stations.text: Prints a red error and no report.

stations.title: Morning report
stations.text: Four lines Ines reads before opening.

captions: Day two at Wickhollow Candles. Ines asks why the morning report is all red.
Theo changed the file last night, and now Node stops before it prints a thing.
You fix the lines Node cannot read, in four small tasks.
Now Node reads the whole file and the report prints all four lines.
The red text was a message all along, and now Theo can read it too.
